title: 掌子面攝影測量

summaryEn: Study topic: Tunnel-face photogrammetry. Planned coverage includes geological risks, excavation support, waterproofing and deformation monitoring. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
